# VTech Facades

> Authorized Fundermax business partner and facade cladding specialist in Bengaluru, South India.

- Owner: V-Tech Building Systems Pvt. Ltd
- Founded: 2017 (facades division) by Mr. Ishwar B. G and Mr. Bhargav Panthulu
- Specialties: Fundermax HPL panels, balcony panels, exterior and interior wall cladding
